MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT (v1.0)
This Master Services Agreement is entered into as of November 1, 2026, by and between:
1. DocuMind Technologies Inc. ('Service Provider')
2. Apex Global Logistics Corp. ('Client')
SECTION 1: SCOPE OF SERVICES
Service Provider shall deliver intelligent document processing, OCR extraction, and automated
knowledge extraction infrastructure to Client under the agreed Service Level Agreement (SLA).
SECTION 2: PAYMENT AND FEES
Client agrees to pay all undisputed invoices within Net 30 days of receipt.
Late payments shall accrue interest at 1.0% per month.
SECTION 3: CONFIDENTIALITY
Both parties agree to hold all proprietary trade secrets, customer data, and source code in strict
confidence for a minimum period of five (5) years following termination of this Agreement.

SECTION 4: LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Except for breaches of confidentiality, neither party's aggregate liability under this agreement
shall exceed the total fees paid by Client during the preceding twelve (12) month period.
SECTION 5: GOVERNING LAW & ARBITRATION
This Agreement shall be construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California.
Any dispute arising hereunder shall be settled by binding arbitration in San Francisco, CA.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
For DocuMind Technologies: _____________________    Date: Nov 1, 2026
For Apex Global Logistics:  _____________________    Date: Nov 3, 2026
